subject: Web Development
title: CSS Parsing: The Style Rules
description: Learn CSS Parsing: The Style Rules in one minute.

hook.text: After building the DOM, the browser needs to know how everything should look.

buildup.text: CSS files are parsed into a set of rules — each selector paired with style declarations.

discovery.text: The browser matches selectors to DOM nodes and computes a final style for every element.

twist.text: Specificity battles decide which rule wins. An inline style beats a class beats an element.

climax.text: The computed style tree holds the final answer for every font, color, and margin on the page.

punchline.text: Thousands of rules distill into one look.

quiz.question: How does a browser decide which CSS rule wins?
